pages.text: The terminal's light is a small thing to miss. It looks different when you have earned the return journey.
pages.title: Extraction
Count everyone home
pages.text: Use extraction after all checkpoints and required objectives are complete. Hold recovered cargo if the mission requires it. Completion returns the party home and settles rewards.

pages.title: Count everyone home
pages.text: Optional objectives and fast completion may add bonuses. The mission description tells you the terms.

pages.title: Build on what survived
pages.text: Successful missions leave permanent proof and advance their dimension's campaign. That proof opens harder work at the terminal. A listed mission can remain locked until its other requirements are met.

pages.title: Build on what survived
pages.text: Tokens buy rewards through /expeditions redeem. The reward pool follows the dimension you stand in.

pages.title: Build on what survived
pages.text: The field guide remembers your discoveries after death. The frontier should leave you with more than scars.
